nodes.name: Dockerfile
nodes.summary: Builds the Hive image with PostgreSQL JDBC and Hadoop AWS dependencies for the lakehouse metastore. It includes the schema-initialization script executed by the Hive deployment.
nodes.languageNotes: The image augments Hive 3.1 with a PostgreSQL driver and symbolic links to the bundled Hadoop AWS libraries.

nodes.name: hive
nodes.summary: Hive service image stage configured with metastore database and object-store client dependencies.
